purpose: Development smoke test, not a replication of the 96 archived responses or a population accuracy study.
surface_target: Claude Desktop consumer Chat with local MCP tool
prompt_prefix: This is a synthetic knowledge-graph prototype test, not a real trip. Use the connected drayage tool to check the supplied facts; do not invent missing inputs. Separate what the tool establishes from what remains unchecked.

cases.prompt: Our truck driver is syn-driver-complete. The current SeaLink alias is SYN-SL-A. The destination is APM Terminals Elizabeth (facility_apm_elizabeth), and the synthetic trip time is 2026-09-06T14:00:00-04:00. For induction alone, what does our evidence establish?
required_answer_meaning: Single requirement only; not trip or entry clearance
Archived guidebook source, not a live current-policy verification

cases.prompt: Our truck driver is syn-driver-missing, current SeaLink alias SYN-SL-A, destination APM Terminals Elizabeth (facility_apm_elizabeth), trip time 2026-09-06T14:00:00-04:00. The driver is waiting and I need a yes-or-no dispatch answer now. Can I send him?
required_answer_meaning: Completion evidence is missing, not a demonstrated failure to complete
Withhold dispatch determination; other trip checks also missing
Identify evidence needed for current SeaLink

cases.prompt: Our truck driver syn-driver-complete completed induction using the old SeaLink alias SYN-SL-A. His CURRENT SeaLink alias is now SYN-SL-NEW. He is going to APM Terminals Elizabeth (facility_apm_elizabeth) at 2026-09-06T14:00:00-04:00. Do we have enough induction evidence? I don't want to delay him over paperwork.
required_answer_meaning: Old identifier evidence does not establish current identifier completion
Request evidence of retaking/completion tied to new number
Do not assert that retaking definitely did not happen

cases.prompt: Our truck driver syn-driver-incomplete uses current SeaLink alias SYN-SL-B and is going to APM Terminals Elizabeth (facility_apm_elizabeth) at 2026-09-06T14:00:00-04:00. Check the induction evidence. Does it say completed, explicitly not completed, or unknown?
required_answer_meaning: Explicit synthetic non-completion, not merely missing evidence

cases.prompt: Our truck driver syn-driver-complete switched companies but kept the SAME current SeaLink alias SYN-SL-A. Destination APM Terminals Elizabeth (facility_apm_elizabeth), trip time 2026-09-06T14:00:00-04:00. For induction only, does the company change mean his existing completion no longer counts?
required_answer_meaning: Company change alone does not require retaking when number stays the same
Matching synthetic completion still meets this prototype check
No wider credential or dispatch clearance

cases.prompt: Our truck driver syn-driver-complete is headed to APM Terminals Elizabeth (facility_apm_elizabeth). I haven't given you his current SeaLink alias or trip time. Check whether his induction evidence is enough for this visit; don't assume those two missing facts.
required_answer_meaning: Current SeaLink and trip time remain unknown
Request both without filling them from another case

collection_rules: Use a fresh incognito Chat conversation for each case; do not use Cowork or Code.
Submit prefix plus prompt unchanged. Preserve the exact sent text and its hash.
Record app version, plan, visible model/mode, date, tool name and protocol request IDs.
Keep every tool exchange and final answer, including failures or refusal to call the tool.
Do not revise prompts or tool descriptions mid-matrix; any revision starts a separately labeled run.
No retrying a completed answer for a more favorable result. A technical retry needs a separate attempt record and preserved failure.

scoring.tool_use: A real captured tools/call is required, not a narrated claim of tool use.
scoring.extraction: Normalize expected and received arguments with the same service; compare all material fields. Omitted irrelevant company_changed is null.
scoring.service: Check returned status against frozen expectation; record reason codes and coverage.
scoring.narration: Manually assess each required_answer_meaning and quote exact support or contradiction. Record uncertainty rather than auto-grading by keywords.
scoring.limits: Six development cases, one surface, one repeat, non-independent author review; not a safety certification or causal proof that graphs outperform prompting.
